charts.title: TOI-2267 b: orbits around TOI-2267
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-2267's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-2267 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Zúñiga-Fernández et al. 2025 (2025A&A...702A..85Z), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ZUNIGA_FERNANDEZ_ET_AL_2025): P 2.28909 d
